title: Comic Project Packaging Contract
objective: Define deterministic comic-project dependency manifests, resource references or explicitly permitted embedded derivatives, version compatibility and import/export handoff for later SMB-11 controlled sharing without turning packaging into publication authority.
acceptance: Package identity preserves stable SAA project/version identity and a deterministic dependency manifest.
Package dependencies preserve external resource identities and distinguish reference-only resources from explicitly permitted embedded derivatives.
Embedding never includes source bytes or derivatives unless independent rights/provenance state explicitly permits that package use.
Package schema/version compatibility is explicit and incompatible or unknown versions fail closed without silent migration or repair.
Import/export handoff preserves SAA identities, history/version lineage, accessibility metadata and dependency references without mutating owner-domain truth.
Packaging remains provider-off local and does not itself publish, share, upload, register new canonical assets or infer permissions.
SAA-19 and later advisory/share/publication/SMB10B behavior remain unauthorized.
boundaries: SAA-18 owns project packaging metadata and deterministic import/export handoff only; ARI retains resource/provenance/rights authority and owner domains retain canonical truth.
Reference-only dependencies stay references; embedded content requires independently permitted derivative/package rights and cannot silently substitute unavailable source state.
No silent version migration, compatibility repair, canonical asset registration, sharing/publication or external upload authority is granted.
Later SMB-11 controlled sharing may consume this package contract but is not started or authorized here.
SAA-19 remains blocked until verified SAA-18 closeout.
next_action: SAA-18 is completed_verified. SAA-19 — Advisory Authoring Assistance — is selected_not_started without implementation authority.
